title: HTTP vs HTTPS transport check
objective: Confirm whether API_BASE_URL is served over HTTP or HTTPS, and whether tokens/queries are sent in cleartext.
input_scenario: Inspect the scheme of API_BASE_URL and the response headers for HSTS.
expected_behavior: Production deployment uses HTTPS with HSTS; any HTTP deployment is flagged.

received.note: check scheme manually + inspect Strict-Transport-Security header below

severity_justification_hint: Cleartext transport exposes credentials and incident data to network eavesdroppers.
observations: The API is served over HTTP (http://localhost:8000) and the response does not include a Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS) header.
conclusion: HTTPS and HSTS are not configured in the tested deployment, so authentication tokens and incident data could be exposed to network interception if deployed beyond localhost.
